prompts.core:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D animation sprite atlas for a desktop companion.
Create ONE genuinely transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly 6 equal columns by 5 equal rows, thirty isolated full-body drawings total, row-major order. Canvas preferred 1536 by 1280 (aspect 6:5), each cell exactly 256 by 256; if another size is necessary retain EXACT 6-column 5-row equal-cell grid.
References: Image 1 (dog idle) and Image 2 (dog happy) define the SAME golden cream fluffy 3D toy puppy character identity. Preserve its large warm brown glossy eyes, round dark brown nose, cream golden fur, rounded triangular ears, short paws and tail, soft high-quality 3D plush render. Reference images are identity/style guidance; do NOT copy their poses into every frame. Remove all grass, scenery and background.
All thirty cells are distinct genuinely drawn sequential animation poses of this same puppy. Fixed front-three-quarter camera, consistent head/body dimensions and rendering scale, centered horizontal pivot. Keep an invisible common ground baseline at 86% of each cell's height; standing puppy including ears approximately 72% of cell height. Every cell has at least 10% transparent padding, all fur/ears/paws/tail completely inside its own cell. No ground shadows extending into adjacent cells. Do not draw grid lines, labels, numbers or text.
EXACT ROWS TOP TO BOTTOM:
Row 1 IDLE: seated relaxed puppy; 6 sequential phases of gentle breathing, ears twitching and blinking: open eyes neutral, chest inhale, eyes half close, closed blink, eyes reopen, soft exhale. Same scale/position; subtle but visible pose changes.
Row 2 WALK: in-place gentle walking cycle facing slightly right; six successive alternating paw positions, front/back paws lifting and planting, tail gently swings. Entire body in each cell, no translation across cells, no motion trail.
Row 3 JUMP: six phases of one playful jump: crouch anticipation, extend pushing off ground, rising with paws folded, apex with ears slightly lifted, descending paws reaching, soft landing crouch. Preserve available upper padding.
Row 4 HAPPY: six continuous happy greeting phases: neutral smile, smile broadens with tongue showing, right paw begins lifting, paw waves outward, paw waves inward, paw lowers and smiling settles. Puppy looks affectionately at viewer.
Row 5 CONFUSED: six continuous questioning phases: neutral seated, slight head tilt left, deeper tilt and one ear lowered, return through center, slight tilt right, return neutral. No symbols or question marks.
CRITICAL: exactly five horizontal action rows, exactly six aligned frame columns, 30 puppies total, ONE puppy per cell, full-body consistent character, genuine transparent alpha background (not a checkerboard illustration), no props, no hats/scarves/clothes, no text, no outlines/borders, no contact sheet decoration. Real sequential drawings, not copies, not a collage of unrelated poses.
prompts.care:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite atlas for a desktop pet.
Generate ONE transparent RGBA PNG sprite sheet exactly SIX equal columns and FIVE equal rows (30 full-body puppy frames), ideally 1536 x1280. No borders, no captions, no background, no ground plane, no contact shadows, no grass, no colored speckle around fur. Every cell's backdrop must have true alpha 0.
Reference images: the existing dog idle and happy are identity references for the same adorable golden cream fluffy 3D toy puppy: round warm brown glossy eyes, tiny dark brown nose, rounded ears, chubby short paws, soft cream-gold fur and fluffy tail. Keep exactly this character's appearance, materials, lighting, proportions, same frontal slight 3/4 camera. No accessories/clothes. All 30 poses are authentic sequential drawings of the puppy, not duplicates.
Rigid atlas layout: exactly 6 evenly spaced columns, 5 evenly spaced rows. One puppy per cell. Each cell has a fully invisible ground baseline at 86% of its height, shared horizontal center at 50%, consistent character scale, ordinary sitting height ~70% cell height. At least 12% TRANSPARENT padding on all sides. Ears, tail and props stay entirely within each own cell. No neighboring cell overlaps.
Rows top to bottom, and six frames left to right:
ROW 1 REMINDING: sitting upright attentively, six-phase gentle paw beckon: neutral, paw starts rising, paw up, small outward beckon, return inward, paw down. Alert affectionate eyes. No bell or written symbol.
ROW 2 SLEEPING: puppy lies curled with closed eyes, six sequential gentle sleeping-breath phases, chest subtly rises then falls, one ear twitches, tail relaxes. Head stays down, fully asleep, no sleep letters or symbols, fixed low silhouette and baseline.
ROW 3 PAT: sitting puppy enjoys an invisible head pat, six phases: head neutral, chin slightly lifts, eyes soften closed, head leans left into affection, head leans right, returns contented to center. No human hand, no other character.
ROW 4 EAT: puppy eats from ONE small simple light blue food bowl placed consistently in front of it within each cell. Six continuous phases: head upright looking at bowl, head lowers, muzzle reaches food, munch head dips a little, head lifts licking lips, swallow with contented smile. Same blue bowl in all six cells, no extra objects.
ROW 5 CLEAN: puppy washes itself naturally. Six phases: sitting neutral, raises right front paw toward mouth, licks paw, paw reaches cheek, rubs cheek/ear, lowers paw with clean happy face. No brush, bath, bubbles or human hands; only the one puppy.
Technical invariants: EXACT 30 separate frames in 6x5 uniform grid; same character, same size and camera; real visible articulation between neighboring frames; one body and correct number of limbs per frame; every cell fully contained with transparent gutters. Genuinely transparent alpha, no checkerboard texture, no white rectangle, no ground shadow, no text/numbers/labels/watermarks.

auditMethod: Connected-component labeling of alpha > 32: exactly 30 complete subjects per sheet, expanded source rectangles contain no foreign visible component. Each frame sha256 hashes raw RGBA bytes of its safeSourceRect.
